definitions.explanation: A label used in housing listings, hotels, and other facilities to indicate that pets are permitted. Very commonly seen in real estate advertisements and apartment search websites.

examples.japanese: ペット{可|か}の{物件|ぶっけん}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To look for a pet-friendly property.

examples.japanese: このマンションはペット{可|か}です。
ペット{可|か}のホテルを{予約|よやく}した。

notes:
A common real estate and hospitality term combining ペット (pet) and {可|か} (permitted/allowed). Frequently appears as a filter option on apartment search websites and in property listings. Note that even in ペット{可|か} buildings, there are often restrictions on pet size, number, or species.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペット{可|か}の{物件|ぶっけん}: pet-friendly property
- ペット{可|か}のマンション: pet-friendly apartment building
- ペット{可|か}のホテル: pet-friendly hotel
- ペット{可|か}の{賃貸|ちんたい}: pet-friendly rental

OPPOSITE:
- ペット{不可|ふか}: no pets allowed — the standard restriction in most Japanese apartments

RELATED HOUSING LISTING TERMS:
- {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}{付|つ}き: with parking
- {礼金|れいきん}なし: no key money
- {敷金|しききん}なし: no security deposit
- バストイレ{別|べつ}: separate bath and toilet
